medium: IMPLEMENTATION_QA_EVIDENCE_INACCURATE: implementation_qa_v2.json still describes the dx-more interaction as open/close, but openItem is one-way: once opened it returns prev and cannot close the card. The rendered '－' therefore does not perform the advertised close action.

MOBILE_UNIFORMITY_DESIGN_MISMATCH: implementation_qa_v2.json accurately describes the current CSS as making only the three closed cards mutually uniform, but it incorrectly dismisses equal closed/open card sizing as never being the design intent. The approved game_spec_v1.json explicitly requires uniform height in both closed and opened states, while dx-card remains content-height-driven.

failure_codes.finding: The corrected first-five-seconds claim now identifies the dx-more button accurately, but direct_manipulation still claims that button opens and closes cards. openItem only changes opened from false to true, so pressing the displayed minus button does nothing.

The evidence now truthfully limits its implementation claim to uniform closed cards, but contradicts the approved specification by asserting equal closed/open heights were not an actual design intent. No fixed/minimum card height implements the approved constraint.
